What’s inside LocalLift™

Ten reports and services. One team running them.

Every Friday

Weekly Pulse

A one page read on what changed for your community this week across Search, Maps and AI, and the one thing to do next.

Weekly

Lift Score

One score per community that tracks visibility across Google Search, Google Maps and AI answers, week over week.

Weekly

AI Shortlist

Whether ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity name your community when renters ask, and who they name instead.

Weekly

Map Reach

Google Maps rank scans across your neighborhood, not just from your own front door.

Weekly

Site Read

Your website and specials checked the way Google and AI tools read them, so pricing and offers stay accurate.

Every Sunday

Market Survey

Competitor rents, specials and concessions tracked, so you see the market before it shows up in traffic.

7 days a week

Daily Presence

Google Business Profile posts every day, written for your community and your neighborhood.

Ongoing

Review Desk

Google reviews answered for you, in your voice, with fair housing and privacy in mind.

Monthly

Snapshot

Your monthly Google report: searches, views, calls, direction requests and website clicks, in plain language.

Monthly

ClearView

Your monthly social media report: what posted, what performed and what we are changing next.

Built for how renters search, now and next

Renters don’t browse anymore.

They compare.Side by side, on price, place and proof.
They validate.Reviews, photos and details that match everywhere.
They ask AI.And AI answers with a short list of names.
They check Maps.Distance, rating and what’s nearby.
They look for familiarity.The name they’ve already seen.

LocalLift™ positions your property at every one of those moments.

Why LocalLift™
